confidence_notes: The 2026 food and drink benchmarks are approximate for July. Cocktails and wine by the glass were estimated relative to local draft beer and checked against a few menus. Lodging is modeled for a typical July night, with weekend demand and beach proximity adding uncertainty. [Kenting bar menu](https://siga.uukt.com.tw/), [Hengchun restaurant menu](https://uukt.com.tw/kenting/47923)
comparable_city_reasoning: Kenting price benchmarks provide the starting point, with nearby Hengchun and Pingtung City as southern Taiwan comparisons. The estimates allow for higher prices near Kenting's beaches. [Kenting restaurant price index](https://hikersbay.com/prices/taiwan/p/kenting?lang=en), [Hengchun restaurant price index](https://hikersbay.com/prices/taiwan/hengchun?lang=en), [Pingtung City price index](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Pingtung-city-Taiwan)
